title: Customer Interview Notes: Porto Retailers
body_markdown:
Interviewer: Daniel Okafor. Interviews held October 8 to 9, 2026.
## Common themes
- Retailers want same-day delivery inside the Lisbon area for orders placed before 14:00.
- Real-time tracking links in the customer's own language are a top request.
- Two grocery retailers asked about temperature-controlled delivery.
## Quote
> We would switch carriers tomorrow for reliable same-day delivery. — Retail owner, Porto
Follow-up: Joe Smith to join the next two interviews.
